thread:
mira: Heads up — ap-southeast3 nodes are in an ephemeral NVMe IOPS spiral since ~03:02 UTC. GPU attach latency up ~600ms and a few attach failures. Fast checks point at background discard/trim work saturating queues.
jonathan: Can you paste logs / metrics?
mira: Quick snippets: `iostat -x 1 5` showed %util ~99, await ~120ms, rq-sz spikes. dmesg repeating: `blk_mq: nvme0: queue depth limit` and `nvme nvme0: I/O 12345 timed out`.
kai: Is this the nightly cleaner window? what overlap with batch ramp?
mira: Yes — cleaner started at 02:55 and batch ramp at 03:00. Cleaner spawned lots of fstrim/discard ops; firmware seems to be queuing and not returning promptly.
sre-liz: Any firmware resets or CRC errors in dmesg?
mira: No resets, just retries/timeouts and increasing retry counts.
opsbot: autotriage: region=ap-southeast3 severity=high scratch-iops-spike. Suggested immediate actions: pause janitor, bump io-priority, and rate-limit cleaner concurrency. :robot_face:
jonathan: @mira can you pause the janitor for the affected pool? I can push a hotfix to rate-limit if needed.
mira: Paused janitor for pool scratch-ap3 at 03:10 UTC. Attach latency improved to ~120ms but still occasional spikes.
kai: Proposal: reduce janitor concurrency to 4, change fstrim to small batched discards (e.g. batch size 128, every 30s), and add firmware-friendly pacing flag like `--nvme-burst=128`.
sre-liz: +1. Also schedule a kernel behavior check — recent backport may have altered blk-mq timeout/pacing.
mira: If we don't see stable recovery, plan B is to move hot GPU jobs to eu-west2 spare capacity. Jonathan, can you gate new GPU launches to ap-southeast3 for 10m?
jonathan: Adding temporary launch cap in routing policy. Will throttle new launches by 30% for ap-southeast3.
deploy-bot: route-policy patch applied — ap-southeast3 launch throttle=30% (id: rp-2026-03-21-01).
mira: Monitoring shows write latency down to ~30ms and nvme error counts decreasing. Continuing traces to send to disk vendor.
kai: Please open a tracking ticket with the timeline, kernel versions, sample `dmesg` lines, and the exact janitor config. I'll draft a short triage doc for firmware ops.
sre-liz: I'll also loop in firmware and ops-supply for possible reflash schedule or known firmware bug. :thumbsup:
mira: TL;DR: root cause likely janitor fstrim concurrency overlapping with batch ramp + firmware queue starvation. Mitigations applied: paused janitor, reduced concurrency patch queued, launch throttling, escalation to vendor. Will update if this resurfaces. :eyes:
